scenes.tts: Berzelius ran the most respected laboratory in Europe out of a converted apartment kitchen in Stockholm, determining the atomic weights of forty-five of the fifty known elements to within a few percent of today's values.
scenes.narration: Berzelius ran the most respected laboratory in Europe out of a converted apartment kitchen in Stockholm, determining the atomic weights of forty-five of the fifty known elements to within a few percent of today's values.

scenes.tts: When young Wöhler raced through his first assigned analysis, Berzelius handed down the verdict that trailed him for life: speed without care counts for nothing.

scenes.tts: He had drawn the firmest line of the age — organic versus inorganic, two kingdoms under separate laws — and his whole system rested on it.
